title: Users
subtitle: Invite people to your parent company and manage their roles and access.
forbiddenTitle: Only a masterkey or a super admin manages users
forbidden: Inviting people and changing their roles or access is restricted to your parent company's masterkeys and super admins. Your role is {role}.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a user
inviteDialog.description: They receive an email with a link to choose their password. The link works once and expires in one hour.
inviteDialog.name: Full name
inviteDialog.superAdminHelp: A super admin works only in the subsidiaries ticked here, in every category.
inviteDialog.standardUserHelp: A standard user works in one subsidiary, only in the categories ticked for it.

picker.heading: Subsidiaries this user works in
picker.singleHeading: The subsidiary this user works in
picker.heldNote: This account was carried over from the earlier role model with several subsidiaries. Each can be withdrawn or have its categories changed; no further subsidiary can be added.
picker.noneAssignable: There are no subsidiaries you can assign yet.
picker.emptyWarning: This user cannot enter data until at least one subsidiary is ticked.
picker.noCategoryWarning: This user cannot work in {name} until at least one category is ticked.

roleAccessNote.auditor: An auditor sees every subsidiary of the parent company and changes nothing. No subsidiary needs to be chosen.

invitedNotDelivered: {email} was added, but the invitation email did not go out. Re-send it from the list.

roleDialog.title: Change the role of {name}
roleDialog.description: A role change withdraws every subsidiary the account holds. Nobody is made a masterkey here.

accessDialog.title: Subsidiary access for {name}
accessDialog.superAdminDescription: They work in the subsidiaries ticked here, in every category, and nothing else.
accessDialog.standardUserDescription: They enter and see data only in the subsidiary and categories ticked here.
accessDialog.grantNote: Only a Masterkey changes a central reporter grant. Saving here leaves it as it is.

disableDialog.title: Disable {name}?
disableDialog.description: They are signed out on their next action and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again — then they choose a new password. Their records and audit history stay.

enabledToast: {name} is enabled. They sign in again by choosing a new password with “Forgot your password?”.
authSyncWarning: Saved. The sign-in block will be applied shortly; the account is refused by the app either way.
roleChangedStandardUser: A super admin of the user's subsidiary assigns their subsidiary and categories.

errors.standardUserSingleCompany: A standard user works in one subsidiary only, and this change would give them another. Nothing was changed.
errors.centralReporterNeedsMainEntity: A central reporter keeps exactly one main company outside the grant, and this change would leave them with none or several. Nothing was changed.

singleEntry.companyUsers: {company}: the company's own users already hold {categories}. Nothing was changed.
singleEntry.centralReporter: {company}: a central reporter already holds {categories}. Nothing was changed.
singleEntry.companyUsersGeneral: These categories are already open to the company's own standard users, so they cannot also be opened to a central reporter. Nothing was changed.
singleEntry.centralReporterGeneral: These categories are already open to a central reporter at this company, so they cannot also be opened to its own standard users. Nothing was changed.

grantDialog.title: Central reporter grant for {name}
grantDialog.description: Choose the companies this user enters data for as a central reporter, and the categories. The user keeps one main company outside the grant.
grantDialog.noMainCompany: This choice leaves the user without exactly one main company. Leave one company they hold unticked.
grantDialog.noCategory: Tick at least one category for the companies you chose.
grantDialog.withdrawNote: Saving with no company ticked withdraws the grant.
grantDialog.noUser: No user can take the grant yet: a central reporter is a standard user, and a Super Admin assigns standard users to their companies.
